如何通过HTTP协议发起GET、POST等数据请求？
如何使用HTTP流式传输实现大文件的上传和下载？
如何使用WebSocket建立客户端与服务端的双向持久连接？
如何通过Socket进行TCP、UDP、TLS数据传输？
如何监听网络连接状态变化、查询网络连接信息和进行DNS解析？
如何使用MDNS在局域网内发现、添加、删除和解析本地服务？

当您的应用需要进行任何形式的网络通信时，应使用Network Kit
典型场景包括：通过HTTP协议请求后端API数据、通过WebSocket实现实时双向通信（聊天、推送、协作）、通过Socket进行底层TCP/UDP数据传输、管理多网络连接并监控网络状态变化等
当您需要开发VPN客户端应用、在局域网中通过MDNS发现和解析服务、配置网络防火墙规则、统计应用流量使用情况、或者进行域名解析时，也应使用Network Kit提供的相应能力
发起 REST API 请求并处理 GET/POST/PUT/DELETE 响应 / Send REST API requests and handle GET/POST/PUT/DELETE responses

使用 Network Kit 的 HttpRequest.requestInstream 发起 HTTP 流式请求，接收后端文件数据块并按已接收字节统计下载进度 / Use Network Kit HttpRequest.requestInstream to send an HTTP streaming request, receive backend file data chunks, and calculate download progress by received bytes
上传图片或日志文件到服务器，支持流式上传 / Upload images or log files to a server with streaming upload
建立 WebSocket 长连接实现实时聊天或消息推送 / Create a WebSocket long-lived connection for real-time chat or push messages
用 TCP 或 UDP 与自定义服务端通信传输二进制数据 / Communicate with a custom backend over TCP or UDP for binary data transfer
通过 TLS 加密 Socket 连接安全传输敏感数据 / Secure sensitive data transfer over a TLS-encrypted socket connection
监听 Wi‑Fi 和蜂窝网络切换并根据网络状态调整请求 / Monitor Wi-Fi and cellular network changes and adapt requests accordingly
获取当前网络类型、连接状态和 IP 或 DNS 信息 / Get current network type, connectivity status, and IP or DNS information
解析域名获取服务器地址并处理 DNS 查询结果 / Resolve domain names to server addresses and handle DNS lookup results
在局域网内发布和发现设备服务，使用 mDNS 做零配置连接 / Publish and discover local device services over mDNS for zero-config connectivity
实现应用级流量统计并按网络接口监控数据使用量 / Implement app-level traffic statistics and monitor data usage by network interface
配置 VPN 连接让应用流量走指定隧道 / Configure a VPN connection so app traffic goes through a designated tunnel
do_not_use_when: 需求是蓝牙配对与收发、Wi‑Fi STA/P2P/AP组网，或NFC标签读写与卡模拟，应改用 connectivity-kit / The requirement involves Bluetooth pairing and data exchange, Wi‑Fi STA/P2P/AP networking, or NFC tag read/write and card emulation; use connectivity-kit instead

需求是同账号设备间共享相机、扫描或图库能力，支持手机平板PC协同体验，应改用 service-collaboration-kit / The requirement is to share camera, scanning, or gallery capabilities across same-account phones, tablets, and PCs; use service-collaboration-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已在 module.json5 中声明所需网络权限（如 ohos.permission.INTERNET、ohos.permission.GET_NETWORK_INFO） / Required network permissions (such as ohos.permission.INTERNET and ohos.permission.GET_NETWORK_INFO) are declared in module.json5
目标设备或模拟器具备可用网络环境，且目标主机、端口或局域网服务可达 / The target device or emulator has available network connectivity, and the target host, port, or LAN service is reachable

若使用受限能力（如VPN、防火墙或部分网络管理能力），应用已满足对应系统能力与授权条件 / If restricted features are used (such as VPN, firewall, or some network management capabilities), the app satisfies the corresponding system capability and authorization requirements
inputs: 网络请求地址或域名 / request URL or domain name
请求方法与请求头 / request method and headers
请求体、流数据或二进制负载 / request body, stream data, or binary payload
连接参数（如端口、协议、TLS配置、WebSocket地址） / connection parameters (such as port, protocol, TLS config, and WebSocket endpoint)
网络管理参数（如DNS名称、MDNS服务类型、VPN或防火墙配置） / network management parameters (such as DNS name, MDNS service type, VPN, or firewall configuration)
outputs: HTTP请求响应对象（状态码、响应头、响应体、Cookie等） / HTTP response object (status code, headers, body, cookies, etc.)
HTTP流式传输返回的数据分片和下载/上传进度事件 / HTTP streaming data chunks and upload/download progress events
WebSocket客户端连接对象 / WebSocket client connection object
WebSocket接收的消息数据、关闭事件和错误事件 / WebSocket received messages, close events, and error events
TCP Socket连接对象及接收的字节数据 / TCP socket connection object and received byte data
UDP Socket对象及接收的数据报 / UDP socket object and received datagrams
TLS Socket安全连接对象及加密传输数据 / TLS socket secure connection object and encrypted transport data
网络句柄NetHandle / Network handle NetHandle
网络能力信息NetCapabilities / Network capability information NetCapabilities
网络连接属性ConnectionProperties / Network connection properties ConnectionProperties
网络连接状态变更事件 / Network connection state change events
DNS解析得到的IP地址列表 / IP address list returned by DNS resolution
MDNS本地服务注册信息 / MDNS local service registration information
MDNS发现或解析得到的局域网服务信息 / LAN service information discovered or resolved by MDNS
VPN连接对象 / VPN connection object
VPN虚拟网卡/TUN接口文件描述符 / VPN virtual network adapter or TUN interface file descriptor
网络防火墙规则或规则列表 / Network firewall rule or rule list
网络防火墙规则配置结果 / Network firewall rule configuration result
按网卡统计的收发流量字节数 / Transmitted and received traffic bytes by network interface
按UID统计的应用收发流量字节数 / Application transmitted and received traffic bytes by UID

postconditions.statement: 代码已调用 Network Kit 相关API来发起网络请求、建立连接或查询网络信息 / The code invokes Network Kit APIs to send requests, establish connections, or query network information
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code that clearly uses HarmonyOS Network Kit APIs (for example HTTP, WebSocket, Socket, DNS, MDNS, VPN, firewall, or traffic statistics APIs)?

postconditions.statement: 已为所用网络能力补充必要权限或配置声明 / Necessary permission or configuration declarations have been added for the network capability being used
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set include the required HarmonyOS permission/configuration changes, such as adding INTERNET or GET_NETWORK_INFO in module.json5 when the feature needs them?

postconditions.statement: 网络调用结果被接收并进行成功、失败或状态变化处理 / Results of the network operation are received and handled for success, failure, or state changes
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set include response handling, error handling, or connection/status event handling for the added Network Kit operation?
